text: Redraw this photo (Input 1: X00_exhibit1_input1_photo.png) of the dancer in the windswept coastal field as a hand-painted anime key visual for SILVERSIDE, a creative design studio, to open its 2026 studio reel. Render everything in a traditional 1990s cel-animation look: clean, consistent ink outlines, flat cel shading with one shadow tone and one highlight per surface, and painterly watercolor backgrounds with visible brush texture. Shift the light to golden hour: a low warm sun from the left, long shadows falling to the right across the grass, and a teal-to-peach gradient sky. Add three or four small white petals drifting on the wind. Place the SILVERSIDE logo from Input 2 (X00_exhibit1_input2_logo.png) in the upper-left sky, reproduced exactly as supplied: same letterforms, proportions and silver-to-black gradient, not redrawn in the anime style.
